class.name: JustAMCPServer
class.brief_description: Runs the editor-side Model Context Protocol server.
class.description: [JustAMCPServer] owns the editor-facing MCP transport and emits signals for JSON-RPC tool requests, server lifecycle changes, elicitation responses, and cancellation notices. Most projects use it through the JustAMCP editor plugin or [JustAMCPRuntime] rather than instantiating it manually. Implements the MCP [url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/utilities/logging]Logging[/url] utility: declares [code]logging[/code] capability, handles [code]logging/setLevel[/code], and pushes [code]notifications/message[/code] to SSE clients. Engine output and JustAMCP debug traces can be forwarded when [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/forward_engine_logs] and [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/enable_debug_logging] are enabled. Implements MCP [url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports]Streamable HTTP[/url] on [code]/mcp[/code] with [code]MCP-Session-Id[/code], per-stream SSE event IDs, [code]Last-Event-ID[/code] replay, and [code]DELETE[/code] session teardown. Legacy [code]/sse[/code] + [code]/message[/code] and stateless [code]POST /mcp[/code] remain supported for existing clients. When [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/bind_to_localhost_only] is enabled, [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/streamable_http_strict_origin] defaults to [code]true[/code] so non-local [code]Origin[/code] headers are rejected if the server is later bound beyond localhost. [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/parallel_readonly_lane] is deprecated; use [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/readonly_worker_concurrency] (0 = serial main-only; N = up to N concurrent WorkerSafe readonly tools on WorkerThreadPool). WorkerSafe is a subset of readonly tools ([code]execution.threadAffinity=worker[/code]); readonly alone does not imply off-main safety. Implements MCP [url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/utilities/pagination]pagination[/url] for [code]tools/list[/code], [code]prompts/list[/code], [code]resources/list[/code], and [code]resources/templates/list[/code] using opaque cursors. Buffers recent [code]notifications/message[/code] payloads for replay when clients missed SSE; see [member ProjectSettings.blazium/justamcp/mcp_log_buffer_size] and canonical [code]blazium://logs/mcp/cursor/{token}[/code] (legacy [code]blazium://logs/mcp/{cursor}[/code] remains readable for one release). Supports task-augmented [code]tools/call[/code] for long-running tools ([url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/utilities/tasks]Tasks[/url]), [code]notifications/progress[/code] via [code]_meta.progressToken[/code] ([url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/utilities/progress]Progress[/url]), and cooperative cancellation ([url=https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/utilities/cancellation]Cancellation[/url]). Sync requests honor [code]notifications/cancelled[/code]; task-augmented work uses [code]tasks/cancel[/code]. [codeblock] var server = JustAMCPServer.new() server.tool_requested.connect(func(request_id, tool_name, args): print("MCP tool requested: ", tool_name) ) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_server_started
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the MCP HTTP server is listening on the configured port.

method.name: report_tool_progress
method.description: Emits an MCP [code]notifications/progress[/code] notification for the active [code]progressToken[/code].

method.name: send_log_message
method.description: Sends an MCP [code]notifications/message[/code] log to connected clients if [param level] meets the client's [code]logging/setLevel[/code] minimum. [param logger] is optional. [param data] should be a [Dictionary] or string (stored as [code]message[/code]).

signal.name: elicitation_completed
signal.description: Emitted when an elicitation request finishes. [param request_id] identifies the request and [param result] contains the user response or completion payload.

signal.name: request_cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when a pending MCP request is cancelled. [param request_id] identifies the request, [param reason] explains the cancellation, and [param caller_session_id] is the session that issued the cancel (empty for legacy/unscoped cancels). Cross-session cancels are ignored.

signal.name: server_status_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the MCP server starts or stops. [param started] is [code]true[/code] while the server is running.

signal.name: tool_requested
signal.description: Emitted when an MCP client requests a tool call. Handlers should execute [param tool_name] with [param args] and respond using the associated [param request_id].
